instruction: Configure the system volume control to exactly 40%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to set system volume to 40%. Evaluator uses pactl command to check volume percentage, expecting '40\n' output. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter - no custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Verified that pactl command returns volume percentage as integer (0-100) followed by newline. Volume 40% produces output '40\n'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: system volume set to exactly 40%
Getter logic uses appropriate pactl command to extract volume percentage from PulseAudio
Command pipeline extracts volume value correctly: greps volume line, uses awk to get percentage field, removes '%' character
Metric (exact_match) is appropriate for comparing numeric percentage values
Expected value '40\n' correctly includes trailing newline from command output
Metadata indicates verification was performed on actual pactl output format
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are checked
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The awk field extraction '$5' assumes standard pactl output format. While this is the typical format and metadata indicates it was verified, consider adding error handling if volume output format varies across systems
Minor: Consider handling edge cases like PulseAudio not running or no audio sinks available (though 'pulseaudio --start' in command addresses the first case)
